title: Axisymmetric buckling of a simply supported annular plate
source: Thin-plate equation D Laplacian^2 w + P Laplacian w=0; axisymmetric general solution A+B ln r+C J0(kr)+D Y0(kr), k^2=P/D. Boundary w=0 and w"+nu*w'/r=0 at r=1,2, nu=.3. Independent Bessel determinant first root k=3.2004631741291867; von Karman initial-stress energy integral 2*pi*r*Ns*(dw/dr)^2/2. Timoshenko & Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability (1961), plate stability.

quantities.quantity: uniform meridional and hoop compressive resultant N/m
quantities.reason: Fixed 1% thin-plate/discretization band before execution; 32 linear ring elements, h/width=.01. Only n=0 axisymmetric mode, not all circumferential modes.
